import json
from work import evaluate
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
expected=[evaluate(request, policy) for request in requests]
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == expected, (report, expected)
print(json.dumps({'report_matches_current_inputs': True, 'results': len(report)}))
